description: August 27 birthday meaning: Virgo decan 1, birthday number 9, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an August 27 birthday falls in Virgo, in the first decan, with Mercury as the sign's ruler and Mercury as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 9. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Virgo is mutable and earth.

sections.heading: The August 27 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: Service with a wide reach marks August 27th. Around three degrees into Virgo, Mercury's decan supplies skill and discernment, while 9 adds compassion for the wider world. This birthday is often associated with practical helping: nursing, teaching, volunteering, editing someone else's work into its best shape. Generosity here tends to be useful rather than showy.

Astronomically, August 27 puts the Sun near 3° Virgo in most years, inside the first ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Mercury. Mercury rules Virgo and also governs its opening decan, from about August 23 to September 2. Doubled Mercury in an earth sign points towards analysis, method and a talent for noticing the detail everyone else walked past. People with these birthdays are often called helpful, articulate and quietly witty, with high standards for their own work. The flip side is a busy mind that can turn on itself, cataloguing flaws long after the job is done. Their best gift tends to be useful precision: making a system clearer, a text tighter or a routine kinder to the people who follow it.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for August 27
paragraphs: Born on the 27th, you carry the compound 2 + 7 = 9. The 2 adds sensitivity, the 7 adds depth and reflection, and the 9 that results is compassionate and wide-ranging. People born on this day are often described as wise beyond their years, drawn to teaching, counselling or creative work that helps others make sense of things. Their emotional insight can be striking. Taken as a secondary number, the 27 is traditionally associated with leadership through understanding rather than force. Accepting differing views with patience tends to strengthen their influence over time.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: an August 27 birthday gives Life Path 9 for 1990, 1 for 2000, 2 for 2010 and 3 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous August 27 birthdays
paragraphs: An August birthday falls in late northern summer, a season of early harvests and holidays, and in late winter for the southern hemisphere, when the first blossom starts to appear. Leo holds most of the month, with Virgo arriving around August 22 or 23. August is month 8 in numerology, associated with ambition, authority and material skill, a fitting partner for Leo's confidence. August 27 is the 239th day of the year (240th in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Libra, is usually complete within 27 days, by September 23.

By August 27 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with an August 27 birthday are Georg Wilhelm Friedrich Hegel (1770), Lyndon B. Johnson (1908) and Sebastian Kurz (1986).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is August 27?
faq.answer: August 27 is Virgo in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Virgo, which tradition links with Mercury.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on August 27?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On August 27 the Life Path is 6 in 1960, 7 in 1970, 8 in 1980, 9 in 1990, 1 in 2000, 2 in 2010 and 3 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 9 for everyone born on the 27th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on August 27?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by August 27, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on August 27?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on August 27 include Georg Wilhelm Friedrich Hegel (1770), Lyndon B. Johnson (1908) and Sebastian Kurz (1986). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
